sections:
👻 *Ghost Hunt*
- You can now enable it in a community even if it's already enable in one of its chats. You'll be asked if you want to disable there and enable in the current chat.

👻 *Ghost Hunt*
- Ranking now shows top 10 (previously top 5)

🤡 *Meme Generator*
- Fixed: long words no longer overflow the image

⚙️ *Administration*
- New: {{mute}}/{{unmute}} — silence members natively (ManyBot-level, ignores all commands)
- New: {{todos}}/{{admins}} — mention all members or admins; {{mute all}} spans the whole community
- New: {{close}}/{{open}} — lock or unlock groups, with scheduled close/open support
- New: {{warn}} — send a private warning with the rule text to someone's DM
- New: {{get-pfp}}/{{get-name}} — fetch profile photo or display name of any member
- New: {{transcrever}} — transcribe audio messages with AI (Whisper via Groq)
- New: @roles — mention groups of members like Discord roles

🌐 *Language support*
- New: {{language}} — switch Many's language per-user (pt and en available)
- Most commands translated to pt-BR and en-US

📋 *Menu & UX*
- Dev Utils now shown in the menu
- Autocorrect UX improved: no longer reads as a question; also fixes commands with trailing punctuation
- Autocorrect now only fires when the message starts with the command pattern

👻 *Halloween*
- New: {{caçafantasma}} — Halloween-exclusive ghost hunt game, community-wide ranking

🎲 *New commands*
- {{roll}} — roll dice (e.g. !roll d20, !roll 2d6)
- {{papa}} — pope holding a photo meme
- {{brat}}, {{brat2}} — brat-style meme images
- {{handshake}}, {{kill}} — new social actions
- {{ship}} — compatibility between two members
- {{minas}} — cooperative minesweeper

🔧 *Fixes & improvements*
- Response speed improved for multiple simultaneous chats
- ManyBot updated to v5.13
- {{add}} command removed; just send a group invite and I'll ask for confirmation before joining

plugins.name: ❓ Help
plugins.description:
Not sure what I do? It's simple:

{{many}} -> shows the command categories
{{many category name}} -> shows the commands in that category
{{help command name}} -> explains a specific command in detail

Example: send {{help figurinha}} to learn how to create stickers, or {{many jogos}} to see the available games.

I also respond to: {{ola}}, {{hello}}, {{ajuda}}

💡 If more than 3 days go by without talking to me, I'll introduce myself again when you come back — just so you don't forget me :3!

plugins.name: ❤️ Contribute!
plugins.description:
Spotted a bug and want to report it? Send:
{{bug description of the problem}}
This sends the last 10 messages from the chat along with your description to the developers, with no personal information like your number, name or ID.

Want to suggest a new command or feature for Many?
{{sugestao description of your suggestion}}
This sends your suggestion directly to the developers!

💡 If needed, developers can reply to you directly about the report, without exposing your personal data to them.

Thank you for wanting to support the project!! ❤️❤️

plugins.name: 🖼️ Stickers
plugins.description:
Turns any image, video or GIF into a WhatsApp sticker. You can also extract the image from stickers using {{f extrair}}.

Two ways to use it:

*Quick:* send an image with {{f}} as the caption, or reply to an already-sent image with the command.

*Batch:* send {{f lote}} to open a session. Then just send up to 30 media files in a row, different types if you want. When you're done, send {{f lote criar}} and I'll convert them all at once! To cancel, send {{f lote parar}}.

💡 Tip: to create transparent stickers, send the image as a document:

1. Tap the clip 📎 (next to the camera)
2. Choose the transparent image (PNG)
3. Put {{f}} as the caption
4. Send!

This also works for documents sent earlier: just reply to them with the command, no need to resend.

✏️ To edit the sticker name and pack, use {{f edit pack <name>}}, {{f edit autor <name>}} or {{f edit reset}} to restore the default.

plugins.name: 📺 Download Videos or Audio
plugins.description:
Downloads videos and music from links and sends you a download link! 📥

Works with YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit and much more.

How to use:
{{baixar-video video link}} -> downloads the video
{{baixar-audio video link}} -> downloads audio only (great for music!)

Example:
{{video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ}}

💡 Tip: paste the link together with the command, in the same message.

plugins.name: 🤖 Many AI
plugins.description:
Ask me anything and I'll answer with AI! 🧠

It can be anything: questions, summaries, translations, explanations, fun facts... Just ask!

Remember to mention "Many" in your message, otherwise she won't know you're talking to her.

*Audio transcription:*
Reply to any audio with {{transcrever}} and I'll convert it to text using AI (Whisper via Groq).

plugins.name: ▶️ Play Music & Videos
plugins.description:
Downloads audio and video from a search term or link, and sends it directly here in the chat — no need to open any links. Also plays saved playlists.

How to use:
{{mp3 term or song name}} -> sends the audio
{{mp4 term or video link}} -> sends the video

Playlists (audio only):
{{mp3 playlist}} -> creates a new one
{{mp3 playlist <name> add <term>}} -> adds a song
{{mp3 playlist <name>}} -> plays the whole playlist
{{mp3 playlist <name> info}} -> lists the songs
{{mp3 playlist <name> zip}} -> sends everything as a .zip
{{mp3 playlist list}} -> lists your playlists

Examples:
{{mp3 minecraft rap}}
{{mp4 https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ}}

💡 Difference from {{video}}/{{audio}}: those send you a download link — here the audio or video arrives ready in the chat.

plugins.name: 🎮 Hangman
plugins.description:
The classic hangman game, right here on WhatsApp! 🪢

How to play:
{{forca começar}} -> starts a match
Then just send one letter per message to try to guess the word
{{forca parar}} -> cancels the current match

💡 Watch out — guesses are limited!

plugins.name: 🎮 Number Guessing
plugins.description:
Guess the number I'm thinking of! 🔢

How to play:
{{adivinhacao começar}} -> I pick a secret number
Then just send a number per message to try to guess
I'll tell you if it's higher or lower, until you get it right!
{{adivinhacao parar}} -> gives up on the current match

plugins.name: ➕ Counting
plugins.description:
Counting game:

Send the next number in the sequence.
You can't count twice in a row — you have to wait for someone else to continue.
Any mistake resets the count!

*Setup:*

{{counting on}} - enables the game in the current group
{{counting off}} - disables the game in the current group

plugins.name: 🤡 Meme Generator
❌ Tic-Tac-Toe
plugins.description: Reply to the message of the person you want to challenge with {{velha}}. To play, each player types the coordinate where they want to place their piece. Example: column A and row 2 -> A2 or 2A. Simple as that.

plugins.name: 👉 Actions
plugins.description:
Sends an animated reaction gif to another person in the group. To use it, mention (@) the person or reply to their message with the command — for example {{hug @person}} or by replying to a message with {{kiss}}. If you try to use it on yourself, the bot will warn you and won't send the gif.
Available commands: {{hug}}, {{kiss}}, {{slap}}, {{pat}}, {{poke}}, {{bite}}, {{kick}}, {{punch}}, {{tickle}}, {{wave}} and {{dance}}. Gifs come from an anime gallery API, but each group can also have its own local gif themes.
Use {{actiontheme}} alone to see the current theme and the list of available local themes, or {{actiontheme <name>}} to switch the theme used by the commands above. Switching themes can only be done by administrators when used inside a group.

plugins.name: 👋 Welcome
plugins.description:
Welcome new members in the coolest way possible!

Send {{welcome config}} to start the setup wizard, which guides you step by step. After that, whenever someone joins the group I'll send a personalized card with their profile photo!

Best suited for large groups and communities. In small friend groups, you usually don't need to set it up.

plugins.name: 🚫 Unknown Link Blocker
plugins.description:
The name says it all: don't let anyone send suspicious links that could take you to unknown places.

But not all links are blocked — some allowed domains are listed below:
- youtube.com
- youtu.be
- instagram.com
- twitter.com
- x.com
- tiktok.com
- wikipedia.org
- github.com
- google.com
- stxerr.dev
- manybot.org

Soon I'll allow you to configure which links to block and which to allow.

plugins.name: 🏷️ Roles
plugins.description:
Mention groups of members using @roles — just like Discord roles!

Create roles with an emoji and name, add members, and mention everyone in a role at once by typing @role_name in chat.

@role_name -> mentions all members of that role (just type it in any message)
{{cargo status}} -> lists all created roles and how many members each has
{{cargo membros <name>}} -> lists and mentions the members of a specific role

_Admin commands (admins only):_
{{cargo criar <name> <emoji>}} -> creates a new role
{{cargo apagar <name>}} -> deletes a role
{{cargo emoji <name> <emoji>}} -> changes the role's emoji
{{cargo add <name>}} -> adds mentioned or replied members to the role
{{cargo remover <name>}} -> removes members from the role

💡 Roles are shared across the whole community.

plugins.name: 📋 Rules
plugins.description:
Manage the group's rules and warn members who break them.

{{rules}} -> shows the current rules
{{rules add <text>}} -> adds a new rule (optionally with penalty: {{rules add <text> | penalty: <penalty>}})
{{rules rm <number>}} -> removes a rule
{{rules mv <number> up/down}} -> reorders rules

{{warn @person <rule number>}} -> sends the rule to the person's DM as a private warning. Works great alongside {{welcome}} to keep new members informed.

plugins.name: 🎂 Birthdays
plugins.description:
Register group members' birthdays and I'll automatically notify everyone on the day! 🎉

{{niver add DD/MM @member}} -> registers (or mention/reply to the person)
{{niver rm @member}} -> removes a registered birthday
{{niver horario HH:MM}} -> sets the notification time (default 00:00)
{{niver list}} -> lists all birthdays registered in the group

💡 Only administrators can register, remove or change the time. Only works in groups.

plugins.name: ➕ Add to Group
plugins.description:
Want to add me to another group? Just send me the group invite link and I'll ask for confirmation before joining.

If the group requires admin approval, I'll let you know that I'm waiting to be accepted.

plugins.name: 🔄 File Converter
plugins.description:
Converts files between formats using ffmpeg. Send the file with the command as the caption, or reply to a media file with the command.

{{video-audio}} -> extracts audio from a video as mp3
{{video-gif}} -> turns a video into a gif (max 15s)
{{gif-video}} -> turns a gif into a video
{{foto-pdf}} -> turns a photo into a PDF
{{pdf-foto}} -> turns each page of a PDF into a photo and sends them in sequence

💡 Add `link` after the command (e.g. {{video-audio link}}) to receive a download link instead of the file directly in the chat.

plugins.name: 🔨 Administration
plugins.description:
Administration commands to keep order in the group — most require admin rights:

{{ban}} -> removes someone from every group in the community (mention or reply)

{{promote}} / {{demote}} -> grants or removes admin rights (mention or reply)

{{mute <time>}} / {{unmute}} -> silences someone, deleting their messages while it lasts. Time is optional (e.g. {{mute 10m}}, {{mute 2h}}); without it the mute is permanent until {{unmute}}

{{todos}} / {{admins}} -> mentions all members or only admins in the group. {{mute all}} spans the whole community

{{close}} / {{open}} -> locks or unlocks the group (admins-only mode). Supports scheduled close/open with {{close agenda}}

{{antispam on/off}} -> automatically removes anyone who sends too many messages in a short period

{{cleanmsg <count>}} -> deletes someone's last messages, up to 100 at a time (mention or reply)

{{autoban on/off}} -> auto-removes anyone who joins with a blocked number, area code or country code. {{autoban list}} shows the list, {{autoban add/remove numero|ddd|cc <value>}} edits it

{{get-pfp @person}} -> gets someone's profile photo

{{get-name @person}} -> gets someone's display name

{{transcrever}} -> reply to an audio message to transcribe it using AI (Whisper/Groq)

{{cargo criar <name> <emoji>}} -> creates a mentionable role in the group
{{cargo apagar <name>}} -> deletes a role
{{cargo emoji <name> <emoji>}} -> changes the role emoji
{{cargo add <name>}} -> adds members to the role (mention or reply)
{{cargo remover <name>}} -> removes members from the role

plugins.name: 💻 Dev Utils
plugins.description:
Useful commands for developers or anyone debugging Many integrations.

{{ping}} -> replies with Pong! (latency check)
{{lid}} -> mention or reply to someone to see their LID
{{jid}} -> shows the JID of the current group

plugins.name: 🌐 Language
plugins.description:
Change Many's language for you.

{{language}} -> shows the current language and available languages
{{language <code>}} -> changes the language (e.g. {{language pt}}, {{language en}})

💡 Language is per-user — changing yours doesn't affect others.

plugins.name: 👻 Ghost Hunt
plugins.description:
Halloween-exclusive game — ghosts appear randomly in the group every 10–60 minutes. Be the first to send {{catch}} before the ghost vanishes (15 seconds)!

Ghosts have 5 rarities — Common 👻 (1pt), Uncommon 🕷️ (2pts), Rare 🦇 (3pts), Epic 💀 (5pts), Legendary 🎃 (10pts). Rarity is only revealed when caught or escaped.

Points are shared across the community (if linked).

{{ghosthunt}} — view rules and current ranking
{{catch}} — catch the ghost when it appears
{{ghosthunt confirm}} — enable the game _(admin)_
{{ghosthunt deactivate}} — disable the game _(admin)_
